correctness.rationale: For the complete real plane, 3/2<t<2, the periodic-max argument bounds any period-dividing-four orbit in [-1,1]^2. If x-t>=y on an orbit, forced consecutive states contradict four-periodicity, so the scalar recurrence a_{k+2}=max(a_{k+1}+1-t,1-max(0,2a_k)) applies. The finite D,S,H branch partition gives 3^4=81 affine mode systems; all except DDDD are nonsingular and DDDD contradicts t>1. The inspected exact Fraction solver enumerates feasible words HHHH plus rotations HSDD and HSHD (nine words total); HHHH is fixed, the other two cycles are primitive. At 5/3 the cycles coalesce; below neither exists. Strict-branch Jacobian products equal zero and [[4,0],[4,0]], respectively. Independently evaluated exact rational cycles at t=5/3,7/4,19/10, including collision; finite samples are not the proof—the symbolic 81-branch elimination plus analytic global reduction is. No Floquet differentiability asserted on the switching boundary.
